newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Andina workers launch strike.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Andina workers launch strike.

text.p: Workers at Chile's main Coca-Cola botter, Embotelladora Andina, began an indefinite strike on Monday after wage negotiations broke down, union officials said.

The striking workers, demanding a two-year contract with a basic wage increase of 25,000 pesos ($59) per year, are grouped into two unions accounting for 645 of the company's 1,000-odd workers, said Guillermo Arriagada, president of the National Federation of Beverage Worker Unions.
Andina officials were not available for comment.
Arriagada said the company was offering wage increases ranging from 10,000 pesos to 18,000 pesos ($24 to $43) and offering a three-year contract.
A much smaller Coca-Cola bottler, Embotelladora Arica, in the city of Arica on the border with Peru, began a similar strike on Saturday but that company is not related to Andina, said Arriagada.
